validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="order">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="quantity" expr="1"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="order">
    <onentry>
      <send event="order.placed"
            event:schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"quantity":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["quantity"]}'>
        <param name="quantity" expr="quantity"/>
      </send>
      <send event="order.note"><content>{"note": 7}</content></send>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="order.placed"
                event:schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"quantity":{"type":"string"}},"required":["quantity"]}'
                target="done"/>
    <transition event="order.note"
                event:schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"note":{"type":"string"}}}'/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<send>` creates `order.placed` data that a transition handling it does not accept

secondary.message: ... fails the schema of this transition

notes: a transition's `event:schema` describes the `_event.data` it handles; this data matches its event descriptor but not its schema (the schemas are metadata: the transition is still taken)
diagnostics.help: make the two schemas agree, or change the data
